title: Cover Pending-only early acceptance and partially installed compacted registrations
outcome: Reader regressions independently prove that Pending-only evidence cannot enter the legacy sighting flow and that only installed retained registrations participate in candidate selection and final admission.
acceptance: Pending-only and Pending plus coherent NotStarted registrations return ScanIncomplete with zero sighting reads; the cases discriminate dropping Pending from observed candidates.

Partial-compaction cases cover nondurable retention, an indexed run and coexistence with an active registration: the active row decides while available, an uninstalled retained row grants no admission, and final recheck refuses loss of installation.
